title: Meta releases the open-source Segment Anything model and a 1-billion-mask research dataset
summary: Meta AI introduced SAM, released under the Apache 2.0 licence, and the SA-1B dataset of over 1 billion segmentation masks for research use.

title: Researchers report a Sims-style sandbox in which 25 ChatGPT-driven agents form routines and interact
summary: Analytics Vidhya describes a Stanford experiment in which 25 AI avatars built on ChatGPT formed identities and interacted in a simulated town.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Alibaba unveils Tongyi Qianwen, its generative AI language model, at its cloud summit
summary: Alibaba presented its large language model Tongyi Qianwen, one of several Chinese companies entering generative AI that month.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: China's cyberspace regulator publishes draft rules for generative AI services and opens public comment
summary: The Cyberspace Administration of China invited comments on draft measures for generative AI services until 10 May 2023.
srcName: 国家互联网信息办公室 (Cyberspace Administration of China)

title: Databricks releases Dolly 2.0, an instruction-tuned language model with an open dataset licensed for commercial use
summary: Databricks published Dolly 2.0 together with its human-written training data so that companies can use it commercially.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: European data protection regulators set up a ChatGPT task force after Italy's action against OpenAI
summary: The European Data Protection Board formed a dedicated task force to coordinate possible enforcement by national authorities on ChatGPT.

title: Australian mayor Brian Hood says ChatGPT falsely described him as jailed for bribery
summary: According to Wikipedia, ChatGPT wrongly claimed Hood had been jailed for bribery, although he was a whistleblower and was never charged.

title: Google merges Brain and DeepMind into one unit, Google DeepMind, to speed up its AI work
summary: Google combined its Brain team and DeepMind under Demis Hassabis, with Jeff Dean as Google's Chief Scientist.

title: Sberbank releases GigaChat, a chatbot it presents as a rival to ChatGPT
summary: Sber introduced GigaChat, a Russian-developed conversational AI model.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Nvidia develops NeMo Guardrails to improve the safety and performance of AI chatbots
summary: Nvidia published NeMo Guardrails, a toolkit meant to keep language-model chatbots within set limits.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Dropbox lays off 500 employees, a cut that Analytics Vidhya attributes to AI
summary: Dropbox cut roughly 500 jobs in April 2023, and the outlet links the layoffs to AI.
srcName: Analytics Vidhya, AI in 2023: The Timeline

title: Italy's data protection authority lets ChatGPT return after OpenAI adds age verification and privacy steps
summary: The Garante lifted its late-March ban once OpenAI addressed regulators' concerns, including an age verification tool.

title: Sber releases Kandinsky 2.1, a text-to-image neural network that accepts Russian-language prompts
summary: Sber presented a new version of its Kandinsky image-generation model, available to users through its services.

title: SenseTime unveils its SenseNova large-model system and SenseChat chatbot for partners
summary: SenseTime presented the SenseNova family of foundation models, including the SenseChat language model, and said it would offer them as services to business partners.
src: https://www.stheadline.com/realtime-finance/3218987/商湯推大模型體系日日新-向夥伴提供服務

title: Spain's data protection agency AEPD opens an ex officio investigation into OpenAI over ChatGPT
summary: The AEPD said it had started preliminary investigative proceedings against OpenAI for possible breaches of data protection rules.

title: Publisher Funke dismisses Die Aktuelle's editor after the magazine ran an AI-generated fake interview with Michael Schumacher
summary: The German weekly had presented AI-generated quotes as an interview with the former Formula 1 driver; the publisher apologised and replaced the editor-in-chief.

title: G7 digital and tech ministers in Takasaki adopt an action plan on interoperable AI governance and agree to set up a generative AI forum
summary: The ministerial declaration includes an action plan to promote global interoperability of AI governance, and ministers agreed to quickly create a forum to discuss generative AI.
srcName: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (Japan)
